description: A styled select with keyboard support, type-to-jump and optional search. Single or multiple, and clearable. Options can carry meta (a balance, a count) shown beside them. With search-url it searches your app as you type, for lists too long to send to the page. Works with Livewire wire:model, including options that change between renders.

consider.note: The options in the page don't limit what can be posted. Check the value with `Rule::in()` or `exists:`, and with `multiple`, cap how many with `max:` on the array.
With `search-url`, the endpoint lists records to whoever calls it, not only through this field. Scope it to what the person may see, and send only the value, label and meta.

With `search-url`, it asks as people type. Consider `limit()` (20 is plenty), throttle the route, raise `search-min-length` to 2 or 3 on big tables, and index the column you search. `like '%…%'` can't use a normal index, so a prefix match or full-text search scales better.
